_note: Nominal catalog sizes common to North American pultruders (inches: depth x flange x thickness). Section properties are COMPUTED from these nominal dimensions (sharp corners, no fillets) in frp.py - they are not copied from a manufacturer table. Confirm against the selected manufacturer's catalog.

vinyl_ester_generic.basis: GENERIC - representative characteristic values for vinyl-ester glass pultruded shapes. Replace with the manufacturer's ASTM D7290 characteristic values for the actual product line.

polyester_generic.basis: GENERIC - representative characteristic values for polyester glass pultruded shapes.

adjustment.basis: ASCE/SEI 74 material adjustment factors as presented by M. Zarghamee (ACMA Composites Technology Day / Pultrusion Conference 2021): C_M for sustained moisture (50 yr); C_T for sustained 90 < T <= 140 F, T in F.
